cross-decoding-experimental-to-control: A classifier trained on foveal V1 during feedback still identifies the same images when they are shown directly at the fovea.
decoding-shape-sensitive-not-semantic: Feedback into foveal V1 carries the shape of the saccade target but not its semantic category.
fef-lo-nonsignificant-after-correction: Frontal eye fields and lateral occipital cortex trend the expected way but fail correction, leaving IPS as the only region that holds.
foveal-feedback-below-direct-stimulation: The saccade target is decoded far less accurately from foveal feedback than from direct stimulation of the fovea by the same image.
foveal-v1-decodes-peripheral-saccade-tar: Which peripheral target a person is about to look at can be decoded from foveal V1, even though the target vanishes before fixation.
hypothesis-feedback-carries-shape-not-ca: Foveal feedback to early visual cortex carries the target's shape, not its semantic category.
hypothesis-feedback-not-spillover: Foveal V1's information about peripheral targets is genuine top-down feedback, not leakage from large peripheral receptive fields.
hypothesis-shared-representational-forma: Foveal feedback during saccade preparation uses the same population code in V1 as an image shown directly at the fovea.
interprets-williams-2008-peripheral-spil: Williams and colleagues found that foveal V1 carries information about peripheral stimuli, which others attribute to receptive-field spillover.
ips-candidate-driver-foveal-feedback: Intraparietal sulcus activity tracks foveal decoding more closely than peripheral decoding, making it a candidate source of the feedback.
ips-foveal-effect-reverses-in-control: When the image is shown directly at the fovea, intraparietal sulcus activity tracks foveal decoding in the opposite direction.
lo-shows-reversed-specificity: In lateral occipital cortex the pattern reverses: decoding across shape falls while decoding across semantic category holds up.
parametric-modulation-exploratory-not-pr: The analysis linking intraparietal, frontal eye field and lateral occipital activity to foveal decoding was exploratory, not preregistered.
prediction-cross-decoding-generalizes: A classifier trained on foveal V1 during feedback should still identify the same images shown directly at the fovea.
prediction-lo-inverse-pattern: Lateral occipital cortex should show the opposite profile to foveal V1, losing shape decoding while keeping category decoding.
prediction-u-shape-eccentricity: Decoding accuracy across early visual cortex should dip at parafoveal eccentricities and rise again at the fovea, not decay steadily.
prediction-v1-category-drops-shape-prese: In foveal V1, decoding across semantic category should fall under feedback while decoding across shape should hold up.
preregistered-design-validates-mvpa: The decoding pipeline, regions of interest and statistical tests were all specified in advance in a preregistered plan.
preregistration-submitted-after-manuscri: The preregistration reached OSF only after the manuscript was submitted, so its timing rests on website timestamps the authors cite.
target-excluded-fovea-in-99pct-saccades: The gaze-contingent display kept the peripheral target out of the central fovea on all but a fraction of a percent of saccades.
u-shaped-eccentricity-rejects-spillover: Decoding accuracy in V1, V2 and V3 dips at parafoveal eccentricities and rises again at the fovea rather than decaying steadily.
v1-category-decoding-drops-in-feedback: In foveal V1 under feedback, decoding across semantic category falls while decoding across shape stays high.
v2-v3-generalize-shape-not-category: Foveal V2 and V3 show the same shape-sensitive, category-insensitive feedback as V1.
